name: Machined Components & Critical Features
summary: 3-axis milled, turned and drilled features within a 1300 × 800 mm envelope, on parts and tooling alike.
description: CNC and VMC machining for the features a press or a weld fixture cannot hold — bores, faces, tapped holes and tight-tolerance locating features. We machine finished components as well as secondary operations on pressed and welded parts, which keeps a multi-process job on one purchase order and one inspection record instead of shipping a part out for machining and back. The same machines support our tool room, so the equipment that cuts your part also cuts the dies that form it.
